scenes.headline: Why Light Bends?
scenes.concept_takeaway: Medium change hone par light ki speed badalti hai, isliye ray bend hoti hai!
scenes.quick_tip: Rarer se Denser = Bend Towards Normal! Denser se Rarer = Away!
scenes.narration: Ruko! Paani ke glass mein rakhi pencil tooti hui kyun dikhti hai? Aur car ka side mirror hamesha choti image hi kyun banata hai? Welcome to Light Reflection and Refraction! Dekho kitna simple hai: jab light bounce kare toh Angle of Incidence equals Angle of Reflection, aur jab medium cross kare toh Snell's Law!

scenes.headline: Mirror & Lens
scenes.concept_takeaway: Mirror Formula mein PLUS (+), aur Lens Formula mein MINUS (-) aata hai!
scenes.quick_tip: Object distance (u) hamesha NEGATIVE (-) hota hai! Never forget!
scenes.narration: Ab dekho geometric proof! Jab light ray Principal Axis ke parallel aati hai, toh Concave Mirror ya Convex Lens se takra kar seedha Focus se guzarti hai! Yaad rakhna: Center of Curvature hamesha Focus ka double hota hai, yaani R equals 2f. Mirror Formula mein बीच mein Plus aata hai, aur Lens mein Minus!

scenes.headline: 5-Sec Numerical Hack
scenes.concept_takeaway: Bina lamba LCM liye Direct Multiplication Trick se v aur m nikalo!
scenes.quick_tip: m negative (-) = Real & Inverted! m positive (+) = Virtual & Erect!
scenes.narration: Start the timer! CBSE Board Exam Boss Question: Object u equals minus 30 cm par hai, aur Concave Mirror ka focal length minus 15 cm hai. Image kahan banegi? LCM mat lo! Bas yeh 5-second Topper Shortcut lagao: v equals u into f divided by u minus f! Answer seedha minus 30 cm! Bam!
